mapper.select: SELECT id, element_key, name, description, icon, color, sort_order, active, schema_json, created_at, updated_at FROM element_types WHERE active = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO element_types (id, element_key, name, description, icon, color, sort_order, active, schema_json) VALUES (#{id}, #{request.key}, #{request.name}, #{request.description}, #{request.icon}, #{request.color}, #{sortOrder}, 1, #{request.schemaJson})
